authorization: Native Aos resource supplies only the read mount and reader group; kernel DAC/SELinux isolate the OEM socket. Read-only bind is not protocol authorization. Reader has no producer/configuration/motion operation or credential.
activation: Distinct OEM target and A/B working directory; unchanged native Safe Stop/update/recovery mechanism. Explicit Vision-only bootstrap selection, never VDP-slot adoption or Main config activation.
restart: No source binding/pixels retained by daemon; an authenticated OEM producer must establish a new source epoch after process restart. Native dependent instances must be stopped/reinstantiated when their resource is revoked.
qualification: Source/static/targeted compile before package/image, then actual native UID/mount/SELinux/activation/restart proof on separate M4 Vision target. Source profile is not live acceptance.
